---
name: {{name}}-review
description: Walk the user through a built {{name}} item so they understand it and can judge it. Use when `{{cmd}} next` says review, or the user asks what was built or wants to review it.
---
<!-- {{name}}-managed: generated by `{{cmd}} sync`; edits are overwritten -->
Run `{{cmd}} review` and go through it with the user, requirement by requirement: the code,
the test that proves it, and any deviation from the plan. Ask the user to confirm each
constitution article listed for review. Changes they want go under "## Review" in the item;
make them, run `{{cmd}} check`, and come back.
